description: map scanner: fix race_condition false positive via nested-closure attribution + wait_for safe pattern
root_cause: _check_race_conditions did not track indentation, so a nested async def closure (on_processing_terminal inside tutorial_integration._run_domain_action_step) reset function-boundary state and was blamed for the enclosing methods 9 awaits + state write without lock
solution: Nested async def (deeper indent than enclosing function) no longer treated as a new boundary; await asyncio.wait_for(...) now recognized as a safe coordination primitive alongside asyncio.Lock/async with. Added 2 regression tests. Race warning for tutorial_integration is gone (10->9 warnings).
